protocol.domain: canonical valid voxel centers via the frozen prolongation operator
protocol.lift: p @ nodal_state (identical operator for every method)
protocol.weak_source_rule: intensity * 1.5 < max intensity within the case
protocol.peak_definition: each source uses its own local peak (GT and prediction)

normalization.note: One explicit divisor per pair; see per_sample[].methods[].normalization for the applied values. Scale-invariant metrics (pearson, morphology) are unaffected by the choice.
